<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,7,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Andra!
Something strange happened,
so we came to report!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0>Yes, at the Chiuchiu Spiral Mountains,
the water shone beautifully.

Looking at the water,
a kind of plankton was glowing
and flowing, it seemed.

<TALK 5><NAME 10>I see...
this is surely the Shine of the Spiral Horn.
This is a great discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
